title: Pandorum
review: Very noughties sci-fi horror, with the cyber goth aesthetic from {Underworld}, {Event Horizon} etc. With shades of the old {Resident Evil} movies, later {Alien} sequels, and the {Doom} movie adaptation. The characters launch into a video game mission very quickly without much personality being established, and the whole thing plays out in very unimaginative and unoriginal way. Two guys with amnesia slowly remember things and tell each other, serving as periodic exposition peppered throughout the fist act. I just didn't care about them or want to learn more about them on a personal level. There were a lot of jump scares but they really sucked, using the most basic techniques and not evolving or heightening throughout the runtime. There are also some action/chase scenes that are very unsatisfying, with quick cuts between dark hallway shots where you have no sense of the geography, or of what is going on. Maybe this was more exciting at the time, but it seemed so generic to me today. It's so serious and yet so uninteresting, and it has so little to say.
